sections.title: How to grind Faz Tokens on Gold Endo
steps: Save right before the tile where you'd trigger his encounter.
Trigger the encounter and defeat Gold Endo.
Go back to the title screen and reload your file.
The encounter should start straight away, because the game puts you on his tile.
Repeat until you have as many tokens as you want.

sections.title: Mid level: Halloween
sections.text: When you reach mid level (level 20-30), Halloween becomes a good grinding area if it is available. You gain 600-1,020 EXP per battle and can toggle battles manually. Outside of Halloween and Pinwheel Circus & Funhouse there is no stand-out mid level grinding area.

sections.title: Low level: best method for each world

rows.label: World 1
rows.text: The slowest start. Just fight the normal enemies here.

rows.label: World 2
rows.text: Farm EXP from Chipper in World 1, with the same steps as Security Owl.

rows.label: World 3
rows.text: Farm EXP from Snowcone after beating him once, with the same steps as Security Owl.

rows.label: World 4
rows.text: Farm EXP from Seagoon after beating him once, with the same steps as Security Owl.

rows.label: World 5
rows.text: There is no right or wrong way to earn EXP here.
